trigger: Pass the culvert by the hot springs on Steamboat Creek.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A culvert under the road. Steam from the hot springs. A blue tarp, a camp chair, a man with a beard like tumbleweed.

nodes.speaker: amb_salt
nodes.text: Stop. Turn the lights off. You're shining right up the draw.

nodes.speaker: amb_salt
nodes.text: Name's Salt. Been here since '09. Warm water, nobody bothers me. Till September.

nodes.speaker: amb_salt
nodes.text: Huh. Thanks. Okay. You get the long version.

nodes.speaker: amb_salt
nodes.text: They've been watching me since September. Tall ones. They stand where the steam is and they watch.

nodes.speaker: amb_salt
nodes.text: They don't come close. Not yet. They like the warm. Your plant up there is the warmest thing for miles.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Pressed against your leg. Shaking. She hasn't stopped looking up the draw.]

nodes.speaker: amb_salt
nodes.text: Your dog knows. Dogs always know. Go on. Light your plant. Keep your lights on.

nodes.speaker: amb_salt
nodes.text: ...Huh. Nobody's given me anything in fifteen years but tickets. Thank you, airman.
